# typesense_nl_search_model (Resource)

A Natural Language Search model (Typesense v29+). Translates a free-form query string into a structured Typesense search request via an LLM.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "openai_api_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "typesense_nl_search_model" "rewriter" {
  model_name    = "openai/gpt-4o-mini"
  api_key       = var.openai_api_key
  system_prompt = "Rewrite the natural-language query into a Typesense filter_by clause."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `model_name` (String) LLM model name (e.g. `openai/gpt-4o`, `google/gemini-2.5-flash`, `cloudflare/@cf/meta/llama-2-7b-chat-int8`).

### Optional

- `access_token` (String, Sensitive) Access token (GCP Vertex AI).
- `account_id` (String) Cloudflare account ID.
- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) API key for the upstream LLM provider.
- `api_url` (String) Custom API URL for the LLM service.
- `api_version` (String)
- `client_id` (String) Client ID (GCP Vertex AI).
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) Client secret (GCP Vertex AI).
- `max_bytes` (Number)
- `max_output_tokens` (Number)
- `project_id` (String) Project ID (GCP Vertex AI).
- `refresh_token` (String, Sensitive) Refresh token (GCP Vertex AI).
- `region` (String) Region (GCP Vertex AI).
- `stop_sequences` (List of String)
- `system_prompt` (String)
- `temperature` (Number)
- `top_k` (Number)
- `top_p` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import typesense_nl_search_model.rewriter <nl-search-model-id>
```
